international.title: Nvidia board reportedly meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s future as chip giant’s share price plunges – follow live
international.summary: Huang’s potential departure would leave a leadership vacuum at the roughly $4tn chipmaker he co-founded, with Nvidia’s shares sliding about 8% in ​after-hours trading Jensen Huang has built up Nvidia to be one of the world’s biggest and most important companies, designing advanced chips crucial to the AI buildout that has helped drive stock markets to record highs and boosted economies around the world. US tech companies are collectively planning to spend $750bn this year on AI infrastructure, a significant portion of which will be spent on Nvidia chips for datacentres. But when so much of a company’s success is associated with one individual, leadership becomes an investment risk … Nvidia has a deep management team, but no publicly identified successor to Huang. An unexpected departure could create uncertainty around strategic continuity, customer relationships and execution.” Continue reading...
